description: Using Epi Info 7 Classic Analysis, read the foodborne illness line list from 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiData\CaseReports.csv'. Filter the data to include ONLY records where CaseStatus is 'Confirmed'. Then, summarize the data to produce a table showing the Count of cases and Average Age by PathogenName and OnsetQuarter. Finally, export this summary table to a CSV file located at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\FoodborneOutput\pathogen_quarterly_summary.csv'.
